6690.text: For external use only. When using this product keep out of eyes, ears, and mouth; in case of contact with eyes, rinse thoroughly with water; do not apply to wounds or damaged skin; do not bandage tightly. Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. Keep out of reach of children; if swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
